author: Paydlux
description: Pays a 402-gated seller out of a 2-of-2 Stellar vault an agent cannot drain: the human's spending mandate is itself a ledger signer, so the ceiling survives a compromised agent. Read the rules, dry-run the payment, buy, then poll for the human's approval.
name: Paydlux — spend-limited payments for AI agents

prompts.name: paydlux_budget_review
prompts.title: Review what I am allowed to spend
prompts.description: Reports the ceiling the human set and what the ledger already counts as spent today, before anything is bought.

arguments.name: reason
arguments.description: What you were about to buy — quoted back in the report to the human

prompts.name: paydlux_buy_safely
prompts.title: Buy from a 402 seller without overspending
prompts.description: The safe order of calls for one purchase: read the rules, dry-run the amount, buy once, then poll for the human's decision. Never retries a buy.

arguments.name: url
arguments.description: The paid resource the seller prices with HTTP 402

arguments.name: amount
arguments.description: What the seller asks for, in tokens — used for the dry run

tools.name: paydlux_status
tools.title: Paydlux vault status
tools.description: Which vault this agent spends from: network, token, live balance, the XLM rent that keeps the account alive, who can sign, and how many spending mandates are live. Read-only.

tools.name: paydlux_payment_rules
tools.title: What the human allowed
tools.description: The spending mandate as the human set it: per-payment ceiling, daily budget, seller allow/deny lists, category ceilings — plus what has actually been spent today according to the ledger, not this process's memory. Call this before buying.

tools.name: paydlux_check_payment
tools.title: Would this payment be allowed?
tools.description: Dry-run one payment against the mandate: amount, seller, and anything already approved and waiting. Answers ok plus the headroom left, or which rule it breaks (max_per_payment, daily_budget, allowlist, denylist, category ceiling). No money moves.

amount.description: How much to pay, in the vault's token (AGPAY)

payee.description: Seller account id (G…, 56 chars). Defaults to the vault's configured payee.

committed.description: Amount already approved and still waiting on a signature, so the ceiling counts promises as well as payments

tools.name: paydlux_recent_payments
tools.title: Recent payments from the vault
tools.description: The last payments in or out of the vault, straight from the Stellar ledger, with transaction hashes an explorer can verify. Read-only proof of what actually happened.

tools.name: paydlux_escrow_status
tools.title: Escrow state
tools.description: Look up a locked escrow by claimable-balance id: amount, when the seller can claim it, and until when the buyer can still take it back without the seller. Also reports who claimed it if it is already settled.

balance_id.description: The escrow's claimable balance id (starts with B…)

tools.name: paydlux_pending_escrows
tools.title: Escrows this vault is part of
tools.description: Every live escrow the vault is a claimant on, oldest release first, with each one's refund window. Read-only.

tools.name: paydlux_buy
tools.title: Buy from a 402-gated seller
tools.description: GET (or POST to) a URL that prices itself with HTTP 402. If the seller runs in approval mode the request is parked for a human: the result carries `handle`, `status_url` and the human's `desk` link — report those to the human and poll paydlux_payment_status. Do NOT retry the buy: a second request creates a second approval. A seller demanding a pre-authorised mandate is refused here, because creating that mandate needs the human's keys, which this server does not hold.

body.description: Request body; sends POST instead of GET

tools.name: paydlux_payment_status
tools.title: Did the human approve?
tools.description: One status check on a parked payment, using the status_url and handle paydlux_buy returned. Polls the seller's gateway, which needs no key. Returns the settled record (with the tx hash) once decided, or the current pending state.

status_url.description: The status_url from paydlux_buy — never the desk link

wait_seconds.description: Keep polling up to this long inside the call. Default 0 = one check
